cap75.name: risk_gbm+every_day+gate+settle+h41+iorb+tailcap75
cap75.rule: on a day that is not a risk date at the lead, the row's forecast is kept only if the tail spread (sofr_p99_iorb_bps) read at the lead's decision instant is at or below the quantile (nearest rank) of the tail spread read on the days that were not risk dates among the previous window scored days, each at its own decision instant; with fewer than minimum_earlier such readings, or when the tail spread is not public, the forecast is 0. A risk date keeps the row's forecast. The curve across thresholds is made non-increasing afterwards, as the row's is
cap75.reads: the tail spread at the decision instants of earlier scored days and of this one (asof.InformationRule, per field), and nothing later
cap75.fit: none: a rule on the row's own gated forecasts at each lead

why_a_cap_and_not_a_fitted_term: step 1 found that the onset warnings sit at a lower tail spread than the false alarms. A term fitted for the probability of a pressure day cannot learn that: the likelihood rises with the tail spread. The input conditions the part as a gate, as the gate of #532 conditions it on its own forecast. Two strengths of one rule are declared (the upper quartile and the median of the trailing readings); no other quantile, input or form
